envoy.verification: Docker Registry v2 response; independent SHA256 of index; selected linux/amd64 child manifest

backend.prerequisite: Import full existing UE image archive into VM1 containerd and register digest alias; VM3 cache is not shared with VM1

limitations: Image identity does not prove runtime compatibility
M1 has no tc shaping or NetworkPolicy claim
NodePort is an explicit application entry, not transparent interception of arbitrary UE traffic
